workflow.text:
name: PatchBond fixture CI
on: push
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  acceptance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Fetch exact commit
        env:
          PATCH_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          PATCH_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          git init .
          git remote add origin "https://github.com/${PATCH_REPOSITORY}.git"
          git fetch --depth=1 origin "$PATCH_SHA"
          git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PATCH_SHA"
      - name: Run frozen smoke tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

after.text:
"""Synthetic order recorder used only for PatchBond StudioNet tests."""


def record_order(orders, key, payload):
    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
        raise ValueError("key must be nonempty")
    # This proposed change only names the copy; duplicates still overwrite.
    copied_payload = dict(payload)
    orders[key] = copied_payload
    return orders[key]
